help.cmd_earn_info.text: /bank earn-info [code] — channels where currency is earned: multiplier, community tax, messages and money over 7 days, who switched them on (bank leaders: their currencies; server admins: this server)

help.cmd_earn_info_tg.text: /bank earn-info [code] [page] — channels where currency is earned, with details, sent to the private chat (bank leaders: their currencies; server admins: this group)

earn_info_set_unknown.text: ↳ switched on before the bot recorded who did it

earn_info_pages_tg.text: Page {page} of {total}; the next one: /bank earn-info [code] {page_next}

dialog_replaced.text: ↪️ This dialog is closed: you started another one in this chat.

econ_menu_community.text: Parts of the economy in {name}. ✅ works, ⛔ switched off. Reply with a number to switch it:

econ_menu_bank.text: Parts of the economy for the currency {bank}, everywhere it is used. ✅ works, ⛔ switched off. Reply with a number to switch it:

econ_set_off_enterprises.text: ⛔ Enterprises are switched off. This community's enterprises are frozen: they produce nothing, pay no salaries, and neither sell nor ship goods. No enterprise can be founded here, and nobody can join one of this community's. Warehouses, members and settings are kept, and the neutral enterprise still covers the minimum provision.

econ_set_off_trade.text: ⛔ Trade with other servers is switched off: sales and shipments between this community and other servers are refused. Trade inside the community goes on.

econ_set_off_convert.text: ⛔ Currency exchange is switched off: /bank convert does not work in this community.

econ_set_off_goods.text: ⛔ Own goods are switched off: nothing but the five base goods can be created, produced or sold here or by this community's enterprises. The daily consumption takes base goods only. What was already produced stays with its owners.

econ_bank_set_off_trade.text: ⛔ Trade between servers in {bank} is switched off: sales and shipments between different servers priced in this currency are refused.

econ_bank_set_off_convert.text: ⛔ Exchange of {bank} is switched off: it can be neither exchanged for another currency nor obtained by exchange.

econ_bank_set_off_goods.text: ⛔ Own goods in {bank} are switched off: goods in this currency can be neither created, produced nor sold, and the daily consumption does not buy them. What was already produced stays with its owners.

audit_econ_on.text: {bank}: {by} switched back on for the currency: {part}.

slash_server_birthday.text: the server's founding day in the union's calendar and birthday posts (server admins)

slash_server_birthday_date.text: DD.MM.YYYY, auto (the day Discord created the server) or off to remove

slash_server_birthday_link.text: Invitation under the greeting: discord.gg/… or t.me/…; - removes it

server_birthday_usage_discord.text: Add the server's founding day: it will appear in the union's calendar, and on the day the union's servers will mention it in their wiki birthday channels. Give /server birthday a date DD.MM.YYYY or auto (the day Discord created the server) and, if you like, an invitation. To remove everything, give the date off.

server_birthday_usage_telegram.text: Add the group's founding day: it will appear in the union's calendar, and on the day the union's Discord servers will mention it in their wiki birthday channels: /server birthday DD.MM.YYYY [invitation]. To remove everything: /server birthday off; only the invitation: /server birthday -.

server_birthday_set.text: 🎂 Done: the community's founding day is {date}. It is in the union's calendar, and on the day the union's servers will mention the community in their wiki birthday channels.

server_birthday_off.text: 🗑️ The community's founding day and invitation are removed: the calendar and the birthday posts will not mention it any more.

server_birthday_bad_date.text: Could not read the date. Write it as DD.MM.YYYY, e.g. 14.03.2019; it cannot be in the future.

server_birthday_bad_link.text: The link must be an invitation to a Discord server or a Telegram group: discord.gg/…, discord.com/invite/… or t.me/…

help.cmd_server_birthday.text: /server birthday [date|auto|off] [invitation] — the server's founding day in the union's calendar and birthday posts (server admins)

help.cmd_server_birthday_tg.text: /server birthday [DD.MM.YYYY|off] [invitation|-] — the group's founding day in the union's calendar and birthday posts (group admins)
